audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gave Sion Levels 2, 3, First item and Two+ items and called Levels 4-5 and Level 6 Skill, contradicting both the packet chart and the already-audited mirror (aatrox__sion).
audit.why: The packet levelChart reads Skill / Skill / Aatrox / Aatrox / Sion / Sion / Aatrox, and the mirror audit locked that same shape. The entry's own whys[] already argue that reading — only the side/win tokens disagreed.
audit.corrected: Level 2 to Skill, Level 3 and Levels 4-5 to Aatrox, Level 6 and First item to Sion, Two+ items to Aatrox. Proposed as matched full/content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes and phase text never named World Ender or gave any real cooldown; Sion's own R range and Aatrox's 120s ultimate cooldown were absent.
audit.why: Both kits carry the numbers: Unstoppable Onslaught 140/100/60s at 7500 range, World Ender 120/100/80s, The Darkin Blade 14/12/10/8/6s.
audit.corrected: Level 6 phase now states the 7500-unit charge and that World Ender's 120s cooldown is the kill window; Two+ items states World Ender healing outlasting HP stacking; the late spike names it and puts Grievous Wounds ahead of it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Sion's abilities were only ever called 'Q', 'W-shield' and 'E'; Aatrox's W was called 'W-pull' and his Q was written as 'Darkin Blade'. The Q cooldown was stated as 'roughly 8 seconds base', which is wrong at every rank.
audit.why: Riot data: Sion Q Decimating Smash (10/9/8/7/6s), W Soul Furnace (15/14/13/12/11s), E Roar of the Slayer (12/11/10/9/8s, armour shred, knocks a minion through the line). Aatrox W is Infernal Chains (20/18/16/14/12s) and his Q is The Darkin Blade at 14/12/10/8/6s — 10s at rank 3, 6s maxed.
audit.corrected: Real names used throughout mid, early, wants.you[0], wants.foe[0] and wants.foe[1]; The Darkin Blade cooldown corrected to 10s at rank 3 and 6s maxed; Infernal Chains named as the drag that breaks a charging Decimating Smash.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Grievous Wounds timing despite Aatrox healing off Deathbringer Stance, Umbral Dash and World Ender.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal for this matchup; the late spike is exactly where the buy decides the duel.
audit.corrected: spikes[3].text now tells you to have Grievous Wounds before World Ender lands, or keep the fight short.

audit.why: Common mistakes already avoid elo language and name the real errors (eating Q3, whiffing the charge).

edits.before: At level 1 you are both feeling out range — Aatrox will try to prod with the edge of his Darkin Blade and establish priority, but he cannot all-in yet. Do not charge Q in the open; the slow wind-up is readable at 15 meters and he will simply sidestep and punish the whiff with a full three-hit rotation. Farm with short auto-cancel trades and use your W-shield to eat his poke, not his combo. Level 2 opens your first real window: a brush-charged Q, hidden behind minions until release, can catch him mid-Q-animation and deliver a half-HP knockup he cannot answer. Land it and trade; miss it and concede the wave.
edits.after: At level 1 you are both feeling out range — Aatrox will try to prod with the edge of The Darkin Blade and establish priority, but he cannot all-in yet. Do not charge Decimating Smash in the open; the wind-up is readable and he will simply sidestep and punish the whiff with a full three-swing rotation. Farm with short auto-cancel trades and use Soul Furnace to eat his poke, not his combo. Level 2 opens your first real window: a brush-charged Q, hidden behind minions until release, can catch him mid-swing and deliver a half-HP knockup he cannot answer. Land it and trade; miss it and concede the wave.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 are Aatrox's best stretch. His full Darkin Blade pattern with W-pull is online and you have no answer if he lands Q3 into the chain — it deals enough to drop you into zombie range without your full HP stacking yet established. Track his Q cooldown religiously: it is roughly 8 seconds base and his pattern dies without it. When it is down, run your combo immediately — E-slow into charged Q stun, W-shield the counter-trade. When it is up, give him nothing and let the wave reset. At 6 your Unstoppable Onslaught changes the math: his R gives him a combat-stat burst but your R covers distance in under a second, meaning he can no longer play passive after a Q cooldown — you can close and force a brawl he must win with drain-healing alone.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 are Aatrox's best stretch. His full The Darkin Blade rotation with Infernal Chains is online and you have no answer if he lands Q3 into the chain — it deals enough to drop you into zombie range without your full HP stacking yet established. Track The Darkin Blade religiously: it is 10 seconds at rank 3 and 6 when maxed, and his pattern dies without it. When it is down, run your combo — Roar of the Slayer slow into a charged Decimating Smash stun, Soul Furnace to eat the counter-trade. When it is up, give him nothing and let the wave reset. At 6 your Unstoppable Onslaught changes the math: World Ender gives him a combat-stat burst but your R closes from 7500 units, so he can no longer play passive after a Q cooldown — you close and force a brawl he must win on drain-healing alone.

edits.after: Land a fully charged Decimating Smash when The Darkin Blade is down, then Roar of the Slayer to shred armor and brawl

notes: Chart flipped to match both the packet and the already-audited mirror; rows proposed as matched full/content pairs. 'Unstoppable Onslaught' in wants.you[2] is a suspectNames false positive — that is Sion's real R name.
